The '''Wookiee escape pod'''<ref name="Insider">{{InsiderCite|215|A Certain Point of View (department)}}</ref>, also called a '''Kashyyyk escape pod''',<ref name="SWMF53">{{FalconCite|53|Secrets of Spaceflight}}</ref> was a custom-built [[shuttle]] built by the [[Wookiee]]s of [[Kashyyyk]]. [[Jedi]] [[Grand Master]] [[Yoda]] escaped [[clone trooper]]s following the [[Battle of Kashyyyk]] aboard one of these craft, assisted by [[Tarfful]] and [[Chewbacca]].

==Characteristics==
[[File:WookieeEscapePod-SS.png|thumb|left|200px|Wookiee escape pods were powered by three engines.]]
An [[escape pod]]<ref name="USW" /> and [[shuttle]]<ref name="Kashyyyk DB" /> built by [[Uurbahhahvoovv Joiners & Artisans/Canon|Uurbahhahvoovv Joiners & Artisans]]<ref name="SV36" /> this conical [[Starship|vessel]] was powered by three [[engine]]s and contained a single seat to accommodate one passenger. The front of the craft's smooth [[hull]] split open to form a doorway and lower a boarding ramp into the ship's interior.<ref name="ROTS" />

==History==
During the [[Battle of Kashyyyk]], [[Jedi]] [[Grand Master]] [[Yoda]] was forced to flee when [[Supreme Chancellor]] [[Darth Sidious|Sheev Palpatine]] issued [[Order 66]] to [[clone trooper]]s across [[the galaxy]]. Striking down [[Clone Commander]] [[Gree (clone trooper)|Gree]] and a [[clone scout trooper]], Yoda escaped [[Kachirho]] with the help of Wookiee warriors [[Tarfful]] and [[Chewbacca]]. They led Yoda to a<ref name="ROTS" /> hidden [[shuttle]]<ref name="Kashyyyk DB" /> covered by branches, which Tarfful swept away from the conical craft. Bidding goodbye to his Wookiee friends, Yoda entered the<ref name="ROTS" /> secret escape pod<ref name="Chewbacca DB">{{Databank|chewbacca|Chewbacca}}</ref> and took off from the [[planet]]'s surface. He was later rescued by [[Bail Prestor Organa|Bail Organa]] aboard the ''[[Tantive III]]'', who took the pod aboard his craft after escaping [[Coruscant]].<ref name="ROTS" />
